plain_text:
Dick Powell appears in 125 recordings across 7 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1941 to 1953. The credits here include performer and narrator.

In this archive, you will hear Dick Powell most often in Richard Diamond, Private Detective, Rogues Gallery, Lux Radio Theatre, Old Gold Comedy Theater, Screen Directors Playhouse, Screen Guild Theater, and Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar.

Characters credited here include Richard Diamond, Richard Rogue, and Johnny Dollar.
